reports.title: Xylem Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Announces

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Xylem now forecasts full-year 2026 revenue of approximately $8.95 billion, down 1 percent year over year on a reported basis, versus prior guidance of up 2 percent, and flat on an organic basis, versus prior guidance of up 2 to 3 percent.

Full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin is expected to be approximately 23.2 percent, an increase of 100 basis points versus Xylem’s 2025 adjusted results. This results in full-year adjusted earnings per share of $5.40 to $5.45, down from the previous guidance range of $5.55 to $5.70. Full-year free cash flow margin is expected to be approximately 10.2 percent, versus 10.2 to 11.0 percent previously guided.
Supplemental information on Xylem’s third-quarter earnings, as well as definitions of and reconciliations for certain non-GAAP items is posted at www.xylem.com/investors.
